skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator to get the fraction-part result.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) from the whole-number part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction result (or convert to whole/mixed form) to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Mixed-number decomposition & recombination
skills.definition: Separate a mixed or whole number into whole and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, and recombine the whole and fraction results into the final answer.

skills.name: Improper fraction-part normalization
skills.definition: Recognize when a mixed number's fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) and convert it into a proper mixed number by carrying the excess into the whole part before subtracting.
